lines.text: Why does a dead battery bounce and a brand new one just thuds?
ai: an AA battery bouncing high off a table in slow motion

lines.text: Because inside a fresh AA the zinc is a soft gel that soaks up the hit.
ai: cutaway of an AA battery showing soft grey gel inside
a soft gel cube absorbing a falling steel ball slow motion

lines.text: And as the battery drains that zinc turns into zinc oxide which is stiff and springy so the dead one bounces.
ai: white zinc oxide crystals forming inside a battery macro
a springy rubber ball bouncing off concrete slow motion
a cutaway AA battery with white crystals inside

lines.text: Then he drains every brand on a machine to see which one really lasts.
ai: many AA batteries lined up in a row on a workbench

lines.text: The dollar store battery costs thirteen cents and dies in 26 minutes.
ai: a cheap AA battery with a tiny flickering flashlight

lines.text: And the Duracell lasts 381 minutes which is almost fifteen times longer.
ai: a glowing AA battery with a bright beam of light
an hourglass with sand running on a workbench

lines.text: The Energizer lithium lasts 723 minutes which is almost double the Duracell but it costs a dollar fifty each.
ai: a silver lithium AA battery glowing on clouds

lines.text: But the real winner is the one nobody expected.
ai: a mystery box with light shining out of it

lines.text: Amazon Basics gives you 32 milliamp hours for every single penny which beats every brand he tested.
ai: a single copper penny next to an AA battery macro
a pile of pennies glowing with blue electric energy

lines.text: So the best battery and the best deal are two completely different things.
ai: two AA batteries on a scale balancing with coins
a gold medal next to a price tag on a table

lines.text: And now you know why the dead one bounces.
ai: an AA battery bouncing high off a table in slow motion
